## REAL Decision Lab

**Resilient Agricultural Landscapes Decision Lab**

Building evidence and decision tools for resilient agricultural landscapes and sustainable food production. The REAL Decision Lab is a developing research program.

<div class="framework"><ol class="framework-stages"><li><span class="step-number" aria-hidden="true">01</span><h3>Observe</h3><p>Environmental monitoring<br>Earth observation<br>Geospatial data</p></li><li><span class="step-number" aria-hidden="true">02</span><h3>Understand</h3><p>GeoAI & machine learning<br>Process-based models<br>Spatial and temporal risk pathways</p></li><li><span class="step-number" aria-hidden="true">03</span><h3>Design</h3><p>Precision conservation<br>Spatial optimization<br>Multi-benefit conservation portfolios</p></li><li><span class="step-number" aria-hidden="true">04</span><h3>Decide & learn</h3><p>Decision-support tools<br>WebGIS and applied products<br>Monitor → learn → update priorities</p></li></ol><p class="feedback-loop"><span aria-hidden="true">↶</span> Adaptive learning: monitor outcomes, learn, and return to observation.</p><p class="outcomes"><strong>Shared outcomes</strong> Water quality · Soil/ecosystem health · Sustainable production · Climate resilience</p></div>

## Four connected agenda areas

<div class="cards two"><article class="research-card"><p class="eyebrow">Observe</p><h3>Landscape intelligence & environmental monitoring</h3><p>Combine monitoring, Earth observation, and geospatial information to understand response to weather, management, and environmental stress.</p></article><article class="research-card"><p class="eyebrow">Understand</p><h3>GeoAI for agricultural & environmental systems</h3><p>Develop interpretable methods that connect spatial information and Earth-observation data with landscape conditions and environmental risk.</p></article><article class="research-card"><p class="eyebrow">Design</p><h3>Precision & multifunctional conservation</h3><p>Evaluate water quality, soil protection, climate resilience, biodiversity, sustainable production, cost, and implementation constraints together.</p></article><article class="research-card"><p class="eyebrow">Decide & learn</p><h3>Adaptive environmental decision systems</h3><p>Connect monitoring, prediction, intervention, and evaluation so that priorities can change as new evidence becomes available.</p></article></div>

## Methods toolkit

Earth observation and GeoAI are growing directions, building on my established work in geospatial analysis, water quality, precision conservation, machine learning, and watershed modelling.

<div class="method-strip"><span>GIS & geostatistics</span><span>Environmental monitoring</span><span>Machine learning</span><span>Process-based modelling</span><span>Earth observation · growing direction</span><span>GeoAI · growing direction</span><span>Spatial optimization</span><span>Multi-criteria decision analysis</span></div>

## Long-term vision

Move toward spatially targeted, data-informed, adaptive landscape management: what should be done, where should it be done, and how should priorities change as conditions evolve?
